title: Heat Exchanger LMTD Calculation
prompt: Calculate the Logarithmic Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) for a counter-flow heat exchanger where hot fluid enters at 150 C and leaves at 90 C, while cold fluid enters at 25 C and leaves at 70 C. Provide the exact formula, temperature differences at both ends, and numerical result in Celsius.

title: Centrifugal Pump NPSH Available Verification
prompt: Evaluate whether cavitation will occur for a boiler feedwater pump with atmospheric suction. Suction pressure is 101.3 kPa, vapor pressure of water at 80 C is 47.4 kPa, liquid density is 972 kg/m3, suction lift is 1.5 meters, friction loss is 0.8 meters, and pump NPSH required is 3.2 meters. Calculate NPSH available.
